rulings.item: makecontext shadow stacks are never unmapped (D-21.7 (5))
rulings.recommendation: a registry keyed to uc_stack.ss_sp that unmaps the earlier shadow stack when makecontext reuses the same stack memory

rulings.item: reference static programs ignore glibc.cpu.x86_shstk=off with hwcaps=SHSTK; libniji vetoes (differences row, no compat option)
the -2 instructions per getcontext/swapcontext fix-forward needs uc_flags written in every mode (a default-mode difference)
rulings.recommendation: keep the default mode exact (net 0 taken)

informational: With GLIBC_TUNABLES set, a libniji dynamic program run directly (libc.so.6 pinned to its install dir) fails to find libc.so.6 (rc 127), the same at 0495c4684; not this branch's
setcontext on a kernel signal ucontext restores x87 env and MXCSR from the user-context layout (pre-existing); the N100 step passes
cargo xtask so writes products under the workspace's target/niji even with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set (seen building a base tree)
start-up opt-in asked on a CPU without user shadow stacks: static +1,309 instr:u and +5 faults (reads its own image, maps cold code); a CPUID test first would skip it

impact.what: static empty start-up default mode vs SHSTK-OPT-IN head (su7)
dynamic empty start-up default mode vs SHSTK-OPT-IN head (su7, stable within the job; cause not isolated)
runtime::start in hot bin 0 (fix-forward: pass only &tunables, read auxv in the cold function)
setcontext from a signal handler to its ucontext with the shadow stack on (was a control-protection SIGSEGV; N100 control)
thread shadow stack sized from the thread stack with the opt-in on (RLIMIT_STACK 64 MiB)
thread_create_join default mode (fix-forward: inline rdssp, about -5)
opt-in on, N100: static empty start-up (enable, lock, shadow-stack map, cold pages)
opt-in on, N100: per thread kernel instructions (reference +13.1k)
